                    <p className="text-xs text-slate-500">Selected Facility / NGO: <span className="font-semibold text-slate-700">{ord.ngoOrRecycler}</span></p>
                    <p className="text-xs text-slate-400">📍 Dispatch Address: {ord.address}</p>
                  </div>
                  
                  <div className="text-right space-y-2">
                    <span className="inline-block bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800 text-xs font-bold px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl">
                      {ord.status}
                    </span>
                    <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-400">Date: {ord.date}</p>
                  </div>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {activeTab === 'post' && (
          <div className="max-w-3xl mx-auto bg-white p-8 rounded-3xl shadow-md border border-slate-200">
            <div className="border-b pb-4 mb-6">
              <h2 className="text-2xl font-black text-slate-900">Post Device & AI Valuation Engine</h2>
              <p className="text-sm text-slate-500 mt-1">Configure brand specifications and select action path (Sell, Donate, or Recycle).</p>
            </div>
            
            <form onSubmit={handlePostAd} className="space-y-6">
              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-xs font-bold uppercase text-slate-700 mb-2">Category</label>
                  <select className="w-full border border-slate-300 rounded-xl px-4 py-3 text-sm bg-slate-50 font-semibold" onChange={e => setFormData({...formData, category: e.target.value})}>
                    <option value="Smartphones">📱 Smartphones</option>
                    <option value="Laptops">💻 Laptops</option>
                    <option value="Televisions">📺 Televisions</option>
                  </select>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-xs font-bold uppercase text-slate-700 mb-2">Brand</label>
                  <select className="w-full border border-slate-300 rounded-xl px-4 py-3 text-sm bg-slate-50 font-semibold" value={formData.brand} onChange={e => {
                    const newBrand = e.target.value;
                    setFormData({...formData, brand: newBrand, modelName: brandModels[newBrand]?.[0] || 'Standard'});
                  }}>
                    <option value="Apple"> Apple</option>
                    <option value="Samsung">📱 Samsung</option>
                    <option value="OnePlus">⚡ OnePlus</option>
                    <option value="Dell">💻 Dell</option>
                    <option value="HP">💻 HP</option>
                    <option value="Sony">📺 Sony</option>
                  </select>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-bold uppercase text-slate-700 mb-2">Model Name</label>
                <select className="w-full border border-slate-300 rounded-xl px-4 py-3 text-sm bg-slate-50 font-semibold" value={formData.modelName} onChange={e => setFormData({...formData, modelName: e.target.value})}>
                  {modelsList.map((m, i) => <option key={i} value={m}>{m}</option>)}
                </select>
              </div>

              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-xs font-bold uppercase text-slate-700 mb-2">Condition</label>
                  <select className="w-full border border-slate-300 rounded-xl px-4 py-3 text-sm bg-slate-50 font-semibold" onChange={e => setFormData({...formData, condition: e.target.value})}>
                    <option value="Like New">✨ Like New</option>
                    <option value="Good">👍 Good</option>
                    <option value="Fair">⚠️ Fair</option>
                    <option value="Non-Working">♻️ Non-Working (Scrap)</option>
                  </select>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-xs font-bold uppercase text-slate-700 mb-2">Action Route</label>
                  <select className="w-full border border-slate-300 rounded-xl px-4 py-3 text-sm bg-slate-50 font-semibold" onChange={e => setFormData({...formData, actionType: e.target.value})}>
                    <option value="Sell">🛍️ Sell on Marketplace</option>
                    <option value="Donate">🤝 Donate to Partner NGO</option>
                    <option value="Recycle">♻️ Send to Certified Recycler</option>
                  </select>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div>
                <div className="flex justify-between items-center mb-2">
                  <label className="text-xs font-bold uppercase text-slate-700">Device Age: {formData.age} Years</label>
                  <span className="text-sm font-black text-amber-600 bg-amber-50 px-3 py-0.5 rounded-lg border border-amber-200">₹1800/yr drop</span>
                </div>
                <input type="range" min="0" max="8" value={formData.age} className="w-full accent-amber-500 h-2 bg-slate-200 rounded-lg cursor-pointer" onChange={e => setFormData({...formData, age: Number(e.target.value)})} />
              </div>

              <div className="bg-slate-900 text-white p-6 rounded-2xl flex items-center justify-between shadow-lg">
                <div>
                  <span className="bg-amber-400 text-slate-950 text-[10px] font-black px-2.5 py-1 rounded uppercase">Automated Residual Valuation</span>
                  <h4 className="text-sm text-slate-300 mt-2 font-medium">Estimated Value</h4>
                </div>
                <div className="text-3xl font-black text-amber-400">₹{estValue}</div>
              </div>

              <button type="submit" className="w-full bg-amber-400 text-slate-950 py-4 rounded-xl font-black hover:bg-amber-300 transition shadow-md text-base">
                Publish Listing & Generate Logistics Order 🚀
              </button>
            </form>
          </div>
        )}

        {activeTab === 'dashboard' && (
          <div className="space-y-6">
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
              <div className="bg-white p-6 rounded-2xl shadow-sm border border-slate-200 flex items-center gap-4">
                <div className="p-4 bg-amber-100 text-amber-700 rounded-2xl text-2xl font-black">🪙</div>
                <div>
                  <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 font-bold uppercase">Total GreenCoins</p>
                  <h3 className="text-2xl font-black text-slate-900">{userCoins} Coins</h3>
                </div>
              </div>
              <div className="bg-white p-6 rounded-2xl shadow-sm border border-slate-200 flex items-center gap-4">
                <div className="p-4 bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700 rounded-2xl text-2xl font-black">🌱</div>
                <div>
                  <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 font-bold uppercase">Carbon Saved</p>
                  <h3 className="text-2xl font-black text-slate-900">214.5 kg</h3>
                </div>
              </div>
              <div className="bg-white p-6 rounded-2xl shadow-sm border border-slate-200 flex items-center gap-4">
                <div className="p-4 bg-sky-100 text-sky-700 rounded-2xl text-2xl font-black">🚚</div>
                <div>
                  <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 font-bold uppercase">Active Pickups</p>
                  <h3 className="text-2xl font-black text-slate-900">{orders.length} Orders</h3>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {activeTab === 'erasure' && (
          <div className="max-w-2xl mx-auto bg-white p-8 rounded-3xl shadow-md border border-slate-200 space-y-6">
            <div>
              <h2 className="text-2xl font-black text-slate-900">NIST SP 800-88 Data Sanitization</h2>
              <p className="text-sm text-slate-500 mt-1">Generate verified cryptographic erasure certificates prior to NGO handover or recycling.</p>
            </div>
            <div className="p-6 bg-slate-900 text-white rounded-2xl space-y-4">
              <div className="flex justify-between items-center border-b border-slate-800 pb-3">
                <h3 className="font-bold text-amber-400">Digital Erasure Protocol</h3>
                <span className="bg-emerald-500 text-slate-950 font-bold px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded text-xs">READY</span>
              </div>
              <button onClick={() => alert('Certificate generated & verified successfully!')} className="w-full bg-amber-400 text-slate-950 py-3 rounded-xl font-bold text-sm hover:bg-amber-300 transition">
                Generate Verified Certificate PDF
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
      </main>

      {/* Interactive Shipping & Partner Selection Modal */}
      {selectedListing && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 bg-slate-950/70 backdrop-blur-sm flex items-center justify-center p-4 z-50">
          <div className="bg-white rounded-3xl max-w-lg w-full p-8 space-y-6 shadow-2xl border border-slate-200">
            <div className="flex justify-between items-center border-b pb-4">
              <div>
                <h3 className="font-black text-xl text-slate-900">Schedule Free Pickup & Partner Routing</h3>
                <p className="text-xs text-slate-500">Route Type: <span className="font-bold text-amber-600 uppercase">{selectedListing.actionType}</span></p>
              </div>
              <button onClick={() => setSelectedListing(null)} className="text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600 font-bold text-xl">✕</button>
            </div>

            <div className="flex gap-4 items-center bg-slate-50 p-3 rounded-2xl border border-slate-100">
              <img src={selectedListing.imageUrl} alt="" className="w-16 h-16 object-cover rounded-xl" />
              <div>
                <h4 className="font-bold text-slate-900 text-sm">{selectedListing.title}</h4>
                <p className="text-xs text-slate-500">Estimated Value: <span className="font-bold text-emerald-700">₹{selectedListing.estimatedValue}</span></p>
              </div>
            </div>

            <form onSubmit={handleConfirmShipping} className="space-y-4">
              {/* Dynamic Partner Selector based on Action Type */}
              <div>
                <label className="block text-[11px] font-bold uppercase text-slate-700 mb-1">
                  {selectedListing.actionType === 'Donate' ? 'Select Partner NGO' : selectedListing.actionType === 'Recycle' ? 'Select Certified Recycler' : 'Select Buyer / Delivery Hub'}
                </label>
                <select className="w-full border border-slate-300 rounded-xl px-3.5 py-2.5 text-xs bg-slate-50 font-semibold" onChange={e => setShippingForm({...shippingForm, selectedPartner: e.target.value})}>
                  {selectedListing.actionType === 'Donate' && ngoList.map((ngo, idx) => <option key={idx} value={ngo}>{ngo}</option>)}
                  {selectedListing.actionType === 'Recycle' && recyclerList.map((rec, idx) => <option key={idx} value={rec}>{rec}</option>)}
                  {selectedListing.actionType === 'Sell' && <option value="Verified Buyer Direct Hub (Mumbai)">Verified Buyer Direct Hub (Mumbai)</option>}
                </select>
              </div>

              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-[11px] font-bold uppercase text-slate-700 mb-1">Full Name</label>
                  <input type="text" required placeholder="Mirza Ibrahim" className="w-full border border-slate-300 rounded-xl px-3.5 py-2 text-xs" onChange={e => setShippingForm({...shippingForm, fullName: e.target.value})} />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-[11px] font-bold uppercase text-slate-700 mb-1">Phone Number</label>
                  <input type="tel" required placeholder="9876543210" className="w-full border border-slate-300 rounded-xl px-3.5 py-2 text-xs" onChange={e => setShippingForm({...shippingForm, phone: e.target.value})} />
                </div>
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="block text-[11px] font-bold uppercase text-slate-700 mb-1">Pickup Street Address</label>
                <input type="text" required placeholder="Flat/House No, Building, Area" className="w-full border border-slate-300 rounded-xl px-3.5 py-2 text-xs" onChange={e => setShippingForm({...shippingForm, address: e.target.value})} />
              </div>

              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-[11px] font-bold uppercase text-slate-700 mb-1">City</label>
                  <input type="text" required placeholder="Mumbai" className="w-full border border-slate-300 rounded-xl px-3.5 py-2 text-xs" onChange={e => setShippingForm({...shippingForm, city: e.target.value})} />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-[11px] font-bold uppercase text-slate-700 mb-1">Pincode</label>
                  <input type="text" required placeholder="400001" className="w-full border border-slate-300 rounded-xl px-3.5 py-2 text-xs" onChange={e => setShippingForm({...shippingForm, pincode: e.target.value})} />
                </div>
              </div>

              <button type="submit" className="w-full bg-slate-900 text-white py-3.5 rounded-xl font-black text-sm hover:bg-amber-400 hover:text-slate-950 transition shadow">
                Confirm Logistics & Book Pickup 📦
              </button>
            </form>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
